description: This file defines the BillingClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which provides methods to interact with the AWS Billing service, including operations like creating, deleting, and listing billing views and resource policies.

classes.name: BillingClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Billing service, providing methods for managing billing views, resource policies, and tags.

methods.name: createBillingView
methods.description: Creates a new billing view with the specified arguments.

methods.name: createBillingViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new billing view.

methods.name: getBillingView
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specified billing view.

methods.name: getResourcePolicy
methods.description: Gets the resource policy for a billing view.

methods.name: listSourceViewsForBillingView
methods.description: Lists source views for a billing view.

methods.name: listSourceViewsForBillingViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists source views for a billing view.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
